editorialPillars.name: プロジェクト・地域活動の裏側
好きなもの・レビュー・考えたこと

growthContentRules: Every article must contain a first-person observation, real experiment, real project episode, or original viewpoint.
No fixed daily quota; quality and timing beat volume.
No more than 3 posts per week by default during the experiment.
One recurring series should account for at least half of posts so readers know what following means.
Use current note contests/topics when they genuinely match real experience; never force irrelevant hashtags.
Each post gets a purpose-built cover whose visual language is consistent with the series.
End with a natural next-episode promise or one-line follow invitation only when a real continuation exists.

currentOpportunityWindows.angle: AIを使って実際に前へ進んだ具体的体験

primary: repeat readership / old article resurgence when visible
diagnosis: high impressions + low open rate -> title/cover problem
good PV + low like rate -> article experience/value/emotion problem
likes but no follows -> account positioning/series promise/profile problem
old post resurges -> create sequel and link cluster

deletionPolicy.reason: Legacy posts still provide baseline evidence and may contain search traffic. Delete only after 28-day dashboard data is captured and replacement profile/series is live.
deletionPolicy.firstRetire: near-identical boilerplate clones and misleading paid/template pages
deletionPolicy.keepTemporarily: articles with likes, follows, magazine additions, search visibility or strong evidence value
